entities.name: Jeongjong of Joseon
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jeongjong, personal name Yi Bang-gwa, later Yi Gyeong, was the second monarch of the Joseon of Korea. He was the second son of King Taejo, the founder of the dynasty. Before ascending to the throne, he was known as Grand Prince Yeongan.
